name: Grade 7 IT Practice: March Week 4 - Robot Systems
description: Practice words for robots as systems and debugging.

words.example: The robot system used sensors, motors, and code together.

words.definition: Data or an action from a robot part, such as a button or sensor, used by code.
words.example: The button press was input for the robot program.

words.definition: The steps a system or program uses.
words.example: The process checked the command and chose a movement.

words.definition: A robot response produced by code, such as movement, light, or sound.
words.example: The motor movement was the output from the robot.

words.definition: The ordered robot commands that make the system work.
words.example: The sequence moved forward, turned, and stopped.

words.definition: To test robot code, find a movement or sensor problem, and fix it.
words.example: The team can debug the code when the robot turns too far.
